name: B10-0540/2025 (PfE) – Escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of the war and the humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to the fighting in Sudan and for talks leading to a civilian-led government. It condemns violations of international law by all sides and urges safe, unhindered aid access. It asks all countries to stop sending weapons to the warring parties. It also calls for protection of places of worship and warns that the conflict could push more migrants towards Europe. The text is a statement of position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring sides, civilians, aid agencies, and countries supplying arms.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, Member States, Sudan's government and the African Union.
